title: Course Blueprint v6 Three-Year Umbrella

assessment_structure.formal_test_week_model: one formal test week per book

test_preparation_policy.default_for_books_1_to_10: no separate printed test-preparation chapter by default; each book carries cumulative retrieval and web-only support unless a later reviewed design authorizes another model
test_preparation_policy.book_11_role: final exam training and cumulative integration, not a separate twelfth or thirteenth book

pedagogical_scope_policy.terminal_targets_source: reviewed target exercises and stronger authority
pedagogical_scope_policy.spiral_exposure_rule: Earlier bounded exposure may support understanding, but later books may not silently assume mastery unless the earlier operation was itself an explicit reviewed target or prerequisite.

authority_notes: This is the owned three-year umbrella blueprint for book-level route, sequencing, formal test-week planning, and the frozen planning count model.
Course Blueprint v5 remains the detailed Year 1 / Books 1-4 source until an explicit migration replaces or absorbs those details.
The pedagogical-boundaries clarification applies across the blueprint route: terminal targets, anticipatory scaffolding, and prerequisite mastery are distinct statuses.
The older three-year concept is useful planning input but is not canonical; it used a 13-book model and contains stale registry assumptions.
THREE-YEAR-BLUEPRINT-MATURITY-BUNDLE-1 freezes the 11-book 4+4+3 baseline, Books 5-11 counts, Book 11 9+4 model, and production critical path.
Structural changes to the frozen baseline require BLUEPRINT-CHANGE-REVIEW.
Official exam questions, correction models, reviewed target exercises, and CLI-backed registry changes remain stronger than owned prose.
Product-route adoption, Scale Gate, diagnostics, mastery, PV, summative use, and student/product use require separate gates.
